endpoints.description: Create a relationship between two elements with its ends set: source/target for directed kinds (Generalization, Dependency, Realization, InterfaceRealization, Include, Extend, Transition, ControlFlow, ObjectFlow, Message, flows of the other diagram families), end1/end2 for undirected ones (Association with end name, navigability, aggregation, multiplicity; Link; ERD relationship; connectors). With diagramId the edge view is created too, through StarUML's own factory and its connection rules; tail/head may then be view ids or ids of models shown on that diagram.

type.description: With diagramId: a model-and-view id (see /introspect factory.modelAndView) or a toolbox item id that presets one, e.g. 'UMLComposition', 'UMLReplyMessage', 'ERDRelationshipOneToMany'. Without: a metamodel class whose relationship kind is directed or undirected.

tailId.description: Source end: a model, or a view on the diagram.

headId.description: Target end: a model, or a view on the diagram.

diagramId.description: Diagram to draw the relationship on.

parentId.description: Owner of the relationship. With a diagram it is passed to the factory as the diagram editor does (default the diagram's owner); most relationship factories file the relationship under the tail model regardless. Without a diagram the default is the tail's owner when that has a list for this type (messages, edges, transitions), else the tail model.

field.description: Without a diagram: owner list to add to; default the list typed for the relationship, e.g. 'messages' of a UMLInteraction.

properties.description: Initial attribute values by name, as /introspect lists them: plain values for prim/enum attributes, an id or {$ref: id} for references, arrays of those for reference lists. E.g. {messageSort: "asynchCall"} for a UMLMessage, {guard: "x > 0"} for a UMLControlFlow.

tailEnd.description: Undirected relationships only: attributes of end1, e.g. {name, navigable, aggregation, multiplicity} for a UMLAssociation.

headEnd.description: Undirected relationships only: attributes of end2.

x1.description: Edge start in diagram coordinates; default the tail view's centre. For a sequence message, y1/y2 place it on the lifelines.

x2.description: Edge end; default the head view's centre.

endpoints.description: Open a diagram in the editor and make it the current one.
Close a diagram's editor tab; the diagram stays in the model.
StarUML and extension versions, factory ids, the metamodel catalogue, the diagram editor's toolbox, and this endpoint manifest with JSON Schemas.

include.description: Sections to return besides the versions; default all.

types.description: Restrict the metamodel section to these type names.

inherited.description: List inherited attributes with each type; default false (own attributes and supers).

modelAndView.description: What each model-and-view id creates; ids such as UMLInputExpansionNode create another model type.

kind.description: prim/enum: value; ref/refs: reference(s) to other elements; obj/objs: owned element(s); var: a reference or a plain value; custom: an object StarUML stores as a string (Font, Points).

type.description: Integer, Real, String, Boolean or Image for prim; otherwise a metamodel type name.

transient.description: Runtime state; not saved or returned.

attributes.description: Own attributes; with inherited: true, inherited ones first.

viewType.description: View class that shows this model class on a diagram.

viewTypes.description: Diagrams only: view classes the diagram accepts.

creatable.description: Which factory registers this name: /create_element, /create_element_with_view and /create_relationship, /create_diagram.

diagramTypes.description: Diagrams the group is shown for; null for every diagram.

rubberband.description: line for edges; rect or point for nodes.

creates.description: The model-and-view id the item creates.

options.description: Presets the item adds, e.g. model-init attribute values or parasitic: true for elements placed on a host view (pass containerViewId).

command.description: A command other than factory:create-model-and-view; such items cannot be created through this API unless `creates` is itself a model-and-view id.

items.description: The diagram editor's palette entries; an id in several groups is listed once.

response.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of `data` in a successful response.

schema.description: JSON Schema of an error response body.
